about: Warehouse first day (trucks, three doors, four docks), 3 h: the Goods in view (design 3.3) and vehicles that choose between docks (4.1).

insights.title: Forklifts fleet is saturated: its 4 vehicles are busy 100 % of the time, and loads wait 8.6 min for a pickup.
insights.detail: Over 2.8 h, a Forklifts vehicle spent 58 % of its time driving, 3 % waiting in traffic and 39 % loading or unloading, and made 35 trips per hour. Loads waited 18.2 min for pickup on average.
insights.suggestion: Add 2 vehicles to the Forklifts fleet (now 4): at the current workload that brings utilization down to about 67 %. Faster vehicles or shorter routes help too.
